units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|log|67|0
units.english: Archons consider it to be their job to enforce peace and to prevent extinction. If they are unable to prevent a species from driving itself extinct, they will still try to preserve some of what that species created as a memorial to them.
units.italian: Gli Archon considerano loro compito imporre la pace e impedire l'estinzione. Se non riescono a impedire a una specie di estinguersi da sola, cercano comunque di conservare qualcosa di ciò che quella specie ha creato, come memoriale.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|They are capable of communicating telepathically.|68|0
units.english: They are capable of communicating telepathically.
units.italian: Sono capaci di comunicare telepaticamente.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|A voice says, "This system is off limits. You should leave."|70|0
units.english: A voice says, "This system is off limits. You should leave."
units.italian: Una voce dice: "Questo sistema è off limits. Dovresti andartene."

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	After a second, you realize that the voice did not come from your communications equipment. In fact, now that you think about it, you're not sure if it was an audible voice, or just something in your head.|71|0
units.english: After a second, you realize that the voice did not come from your communications equipment. In fact, now that you think about it, you're not sure if it was an audible voice, or just something in your head.
units.italian: Dopo un secondo capisci che la voce non veniva dalle tue apparecchiature di comunicazione. Anzi, ora che ci pensi, non sei sicuro che fosse una voce udibile o solo qualcosa nella tua testa.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	(Ignore it.)|73|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignoralo.)

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Why should I leave?"|74|0
units.english: "Why should I leave?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei andarmene?"

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"You can't tell me what to do."|76|0
units.english: "You can't tell me what to do."
units.italian: "Non puoi dirmi che cosa fare."

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"You should leave." The thought repeats itself, insistently. Either you're going crazy, or a creature is communicating with you telepathically.|78|0
units.english: "You should leave." The thought repeats itself, insistently. Either you're going crazy, or a creature is communicating with you telepathically.
units.italian: "Dovresti andartene." Il pensiero si ripete, insistente. O stai impazzendo, o una creatura sta comunicando con te telepaticamente.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Why should I leave?"|80|0
units.english: "Why should I leave?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei andarmene?"

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"You can't tell me what to do."|81|0
units.english: "You can't tell me what to do."
units.italian: "Non puoi dirmi che cosa fare."

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	You feel as if a vast and patient creature has just heaved an immense sigh. "Human, you would do well not to ignore the warning of an Archon. I am here to warn off those who might be harmed by the swarm intelligence that infests this system. If you remain here long your ship will be digested by the swarm."|83|0
units.english: You feel as if a vast and patient creature has just heaved an immense sigh. "Human, you would do well not to ignore the warning of an Archon. I am here to warn off those who might be harmed by the swarm intelligence that infests this system. If you remain here long your ship will be digested by the swarm."
units.italian: Ti sembra che una creatura immensa e paziente abbia appena emesso un sospiro enorme. "Umano, faresti bene a non ignorare l'avvertimento di un Archon. Sono qui per avvertire chi rischia di essere danneggiato dall'intelligenza di sciame che infesta questo sistema. Se resti qui a lungo, la tua nave verrà digerita dallo sciame."

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	You recall that "Archon" is what Drak ships are called.|84|0
units.english: You recall that "Archon" is what Drak ships are called.
units.italian: Ricordi che "Archon" è il nome delle navi Drak.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"What do you mean, 'digested'?"|86|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'digested'?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire con 'digerita'?"

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"What is a 'swarm intelligence'?"|87|0
units.english: "What is a 'swarm intelligence'?"
units.italian: "Che cosa si intende per 'intelligenza di sciame'?"

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"I mean that your ship will be broken down into its component parts." You notice, as the voice says this, that your shields are registering small energy bursts, as if they are being struck by invisible weapons.|89|0
units.english: "I mean that your ship will be broken down into its component parts." You notice, as the voice says this, that your shields are registering small energy bursts, as if they are being struck by invisible weapons.
units.italian: "Voglio dire che la tua nave sarà smontata pezzo per pezzo." Mentre la voce lo dice, noti che i tuoi scudi registrano piccoli picchi di energia, come se fossero colpiti da armi invisibili.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"What is this swarm?" you ask.|90|0
units.english: "What is this swarm?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cos'è questo sciame?", chiedi.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Self-replicating miniature robots," the voice replies. "A weapon created by the Korath, the last of their great abominations. If you wish to feed your ship to the swarm, I will not stop you, but they already possess enough raw material here without your assistance." The voice's tone, inasmuch as a disembodied imaginary voice can be said to have a tone, is sardonic.|92|0
units.english: "Self-replicating miniature robots," the voice replies. "A weapon created by the Korath, the last of their great abominations. If you wish to feed your ship to the swarm, I will not stop you, but they already possess enough raw material here without your assistance." The voice's tone, inasmuch as a disembodied imaginary voice can be said to have a tone, is sardonic.
units.italian: "Robot in miniatura che si autoriproducono", risponde la voce. "Un'arma creata dai Korath, l'ultima delle loro grandi abominazioni. Se vuoi dare la tua nave in pasto allo sciame, non ti fermerò, ma di materia prima ne hanno già abbastanza senza il tuo aiuto." Il tono della voce, per quanto si possa dire che una voce immaginaria e disincarnata abbia un tono, è sarcastico.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Okay, okay, I'll get out of here."|94|0
units.english: "Okay, okay, I'll get out of here."
units.italian: "Va bene, va bene, me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Wait, I have more questions."|96|0
units.english: "Wait, I have more questions."
units.italian: "Aspetta, ho altre domande."

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Yes?"|97|0
units.english: "Yes?"
units.italian: "Sì?"

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	You ask, "Why don't you just destroy the swarm, if it is so dangerous?"|98|0
units.english: You ask, "Why don't you just destroy the swarm, if it is so dangerous?"
units.italian: Chiedi: "Perché non distruggi lo sciame, se è così pericoloso?"

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	The voice says, "Because if the Korath manage to drive themselves extinct, this intelligence will be their last and greatest surviving creation, and we will preserve it as a living memorial to them. Please do not interfere here." When the voice speaks the phrase, "drive themselves extinct," the words are accompanied by an emotion that you cannot put a name to.|99|0
units.english: The voice says, "Because if the Korath manage to drive themselves extinct, this intelligence will be their last and greatest surviving creation, and we will preserve it as a living memorial to them. Please do not interfere here." When the voice speaks the phrase, "drive themselves extinct," the words are accompanied by an emotion that you cannot put a name to.
units.italian: La voce dice: "Perché se i Korath riusciranno a estinguersi, questa intelligenza sarà la loro ultima e più grande creazione sopravvissuta, e la conserveremo come memoriale vivente. Ti prego di non interferire qui." Quando la voce pronuncia l'espressione "estinguersi", alle parole si accompagna un'emozione che non sai come chiamare.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	Also, the empty space around your ship is beginning to light up with small sparks, like an angry swarm of fireflies.|100|0
units.english: Also, the empty space around your ship is beginning to light up with small sparks, like an angry swarm of fireflies.
units.italian: Inoltre lo spazio vuoto attorno alla tua nave comincia a illuminarsi di piccole scintille, come uno sciame di lucciole arrabbiate.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Well, it's an honor to meet you. I'll be leaving now."|102|0
units.english: "Well, it's an honor to meet you. I'll be leaving now."
units.italian: "Beh, è un onore averti incontrato. Ora me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Why do you care if they go extinct?"|104|0
units.english: "Why do you care if they go extinct?"
units.italian: "Perché ti importa se si estinguono?"

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	"Our directive is to enforce peace and prevent extinction," says the voice. As before, the words "prevent extinction" echo loud in your mind as if underlined by a nameless emotion. "Now, enough questions," says the voice.|105|0
units.english: "Our directive is to enforce peace and prevent extinction," says the voice. As before, the words "prevent extinction" echo loud in your mind as if underlined by a nameless emotion. "Now, enough questions," says the voice.
units.italian: "La nostra direttiva è imporre la pace e impedire l'estinzione", dice la voce. Come prima, le parole "impedire l'estinzione" riecheggiano forti nella tua mente come sottolineate da un'emozione senza nome. "Ora basta domande", dice la voce.

units.id: mission:Conversation on Sayaiban|	The presence inside your head seems to fall away, and you are left talking to thin air.|107|0
units.english: The presence inside your head seems to fall away, and you are left talking to thin air.
units.italian: La presenza nella tua testa sembra ritirarsi, e resti a parlare con l'aria.
